title: Layout/ToolPalette
name: Empty
text: MASSIVE point - there has to be a design language overhall - remove all usage of the categories "Generator, Modifier, Logic" as these are completely ambiguous and intuitive. These should be categorised as a Virtual Instruments, Midi Effects (including Midi processing logic), Audio Effects and possibly Modulators / Utilities for any control nodes that dont fit into those catagories

title: Layout/Toolbar
name: Perform Mode

title: Canvas/BlockEmbed
name: Generator
text: This is fundamentally incorrect ui/ux. these are demo controls that are accross all plugins and have no interaction / useability / relevance / control of their respective pugins - its an absolute MASSIVE UI/UX bug and content gap. the blocks embeddings should be bespoke and tailored to each block / node type - for simple modfier / build-in signal flow / midi modfication / utility blocks, these should have pre-built user interfaces which can be controlled directly without having to open the plugins - but until these controls can be identified and appropriately implemented for each bespoke plugin, the main block embedding should have as useful as ui/uzx design as possible - in an ideal world - it would be a visual preview or live view (scaled) of the actual plugin UI for each identification. failing that - useful block processing information such activity, cpu usage, midi / audio / effect type / plugin name / color / user name etc. for now - the block embeded content needs a ground up re-think and redesign and rebuild.

title: Canvas/Cable
name: Audio
text: signal direction needs to be better indicated - also channel. Also the auto draw / layout / ovlapping functionailities are broken (not visibil in this story at runtime) so cable design and presentation is often cluttered, overlapping and unreadable. audio ports need to be more visibile and diferentiated on the blocks in and outs.

title: Canvas/Cable
name: Midi
text: signal direction needs to be better indicated - also channel. Also the auto draw / layout / ovlapping functionailities are broken (not visibil in this story at runtime) so cable design and presentation is often cluttered, overlapping and unreadable. hovering on the cable could reveal  live transmitted data values which would be helpful. it should also be easy to identify different types of signal, so note on/off values, particularally common midi cc values, channels, etc

title: Canvas/Cable
name: Wireless Bus Badge
text: this is funadamentally not fit for purpose - the process of identifying wireless buses i feel should be handled through Bus Send / recieve blocks / nodes so the wiring can still be intuitive. stretch goal, but it would be really nice if there was an option for each wirless bus send and return to also be as a seperate blcok send / recieve (2 nodes) or as a single in / out signal flow node which handles automatically the signals send and recieve with a mix / blend / volume correction  controls - including viewing and managing multiple sends and returns from one single interface.
